title_en: Chinese History (11/20): The Burning of Opium at Humen and the Opium War
note_en: 被迫 (bèipò) means "to be forced to" and goes right before the verb: 中国被迫割让香港岛 "China was forced to cede Hong Kong Island." Unlike the ordinary passive 被 + doer + verb, 被迫 never names who did the forcing; it works like an adverb, much like English "was forced to." The text uses it again and again for the Qing court: 清政府被迫……签订了《天津条约》, 中国逐步被迫开放.
